group.title: Calibration schedule
group.passage:
Laboratory equipment notice

The temperature chamber will be unavailable from August 4 through August 6 for annual calibration. Tests requiring the chamber should be completed by August 3 or rescheduled for August 7 onward. The vibration table and power analyzers are not affected.

Please remove samples from the chamber by 4 p.m. on August 3. Any samples left inside will be transferred to the labelled storage shelf, not discarded. After calibration, the updated certificate will be placed in the equipment record folder.

The laboratory coordinator must confirm the certificate before the chamber returns to service. A successful power-on check alone does not authorize its use.
group.passageZh:
實驗室設備通知

溫度試驗箱將於八月四日至六日進行年度校正，期間不能使用。需要使用此箱的測試應最遲於八月三日完成，或改排八月七日起。振動台及功率分析儀不受影響。

請最遲於八月三日下午四點取出箱內樣品。遺留樣品將移到有標示的存放架，不會丟棄。校正後，更新的證書將放進設備紀錄資料夾。

試驗箱恢復使用前，實驗室協調人員必須確認證書。僅通過開機檢查並不代表已獲准使用。
